title: Oura Ring press band
description: A warm near-black band with rounded bottom corners: a bold uppercase eyebrow, a big featured photo card (cream badge, dark fade, a 40px grotesk headline and a cream pill) beside three stacked cream headline cards with dark round arrows, then a hairline and small footnotes. Phones stack the featured card and turn the cream cards into a swipe carousel with a 1 / 3 counter and dots. The featured photo drifts slower than the page (scrubbed parallax); card arrows nudge up on hover.
notes: dark-scoped (class dark): a near-black band with cream cards under any theme
its bottom corners round 40px; give the footer after it the overlap prop so the footer shows in the corners
the phone counter follows the swipe with JavaScript (hydrate visible); without it the counter stays on 1
